subject: Inspection scope + DPIA evidence roadmap for Argentum Health
messages:
From: Sophia Alvarez <sophia@argentumhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: DPO Team <dpo@argentumhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 07:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: scope for DPIA evidence and inspection access

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed during procurement, Argentum's internal compliance team needs a concise scope and roadmap that shows how Redwood will support our DPIA and Article 28/30 evidence requests ahead of the legal review.

Specifically we need:
- A short list of artifacts you can provide (ledger excerpts, KMS wrap details, retention matrix, SOC2 report reference).
- Proposed sampling approach for Art. 30 extracts (how many records, time windows).
- Who at Redwood will be the audit point (technical vs legal contact) and expected SLAs for requests.
- A suggested timeline for a short remote inspection (2-3 week window preferred).

Can you also confirm whether you can provide an on-demand ledger extract in CSV and a compact DPA addendum covering subprocessor transfer assurances? We are starting legal review next week and would like the material in one package.

If easier, we can schedule a 30-minute workshop with SecureAudit (our external assessor) — they are available Mon/Wed afternoons.

Best,
Sophia
Head of Procurement, Argentum Health

---

On Thu, 8 Mar 2028 at 09:01, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Sophia Alvarez <sophia@argentumhealth.com>
Cc: DPO Team <dpo@argentumhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 09:01:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: scope for DPIA evidence and inspection access

Hi Sophia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our privacy and controls team (Irene) and account lead (Grace) so we can assemble the package.

We can provide the following in a single, downloadable package:
- Art. 30 processing ledger excerpt (CSV) covering a 3-month window; can be sampled or full export.
- DPIA support memo that maps Redwood processing to typical healthcare categories + suggested mitigations.
- Subprocessor inventory and the DPA addendum that clarifies transfer mechanisms (SCCs / onshore infosec options).
- SOC 2 Type II summary and pointer to the attestations portal (we can't share full report without an NDA).
- KMS-wrap details and operational contacts for key management proofs.

I'll coordinate a compact checklist and proposed timeline and send it by EOD (we aim for a 48–72 hour turnaround for the initial package). If SecureAudit wants a live walkthrough, we're happy to do that — Grace, can you propose times?

Rachel
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Request: scope for DPIA evidence and inspection access — package to prepare

Team — forwarding request from Argentum (external). High priority: procurement expects a compact deliverable they can hand to legal and SecureAudit. Please see asks above.

Action items I'd like covered in the initial package:
1) Ben — can you assemble the Art.30 ledger extract (sample + full options) and confirm expected columns and pseudonymization level? We should include a small sample CSV for their review.
2) Irene — please draft a 1–2 page DPIA support memo that maps our processing activities to typical healthcare DPIA concerns and lists control evidence (logs, KV-cache behavior, retention rules).
3) Grace — propose 2x 90-minute windows next week for a live walkthrough with SecureAudit and the Argentum DPO; include timezone options CET mornings or Mon/Wed 14:00–16:00 CET.

Also: do we want to offer a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so legal sees timelines for artifact delivery, NDA, and potential on-site vs remote options? I slotted a stub MAP attachment — see attachments list.

Thanks — Rachel

---

On Thu, 8 Mar 2028 at 11:03, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FW: Request: scope for DPIA evidence and inspection access — package to prepare

Thanks Rachel. Quick status and clarifications:

- Art.30 ledger: I created a sample extract (art30-sample-ledger-2027-q4.csv) showing pseudonymized id, processing purpose, processor location, and retention timestamp. We can provide either: a) sampled CSV (1% of events / rolling 7-day window) or b) full 3-month window export subject to a minimization agreement.
- KMS wrap: operational overview + envelope key IDs are available; we will not expose raw keys.
- SOC2 pointer: legal needs an executed NDA to share the full SOC2 report. We can provide the SOC2 summary and the date of the last audit (2027-10-14).
- Attachments I will drop into the package: 20280308-dpia-scope-checklist.pdf and the ledger CSV.

Suggested redlines for the DPA addendum (high level): narrow audit scope to remote-only and 2 week sampling window unless a litigation or regulator request justifies more. Also recommend a rate-limited ledger export process to protect performance.

Irene — once you have the DPIA memo draft, I can add the operational notes.

Ben
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Sophia Alvarez <sophia@argentumhealth.com>
Cc: DPO Team <dpo@argentumhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Inspection scope + DPIA evidence roadmap for Argentum Health

Hi all — attaching a compact DPIA support memo and proposed MAP (see attachments). Key points in the memo:
- Processing summary mapped to healthcare data categories and risk rating.
- Evidence we can provide: ledger extracts (CSV), access logs (timestamped), KMS-wrap metadata, configuration snapshots of retention settings, and our SOC2 summary + controls matrix excerpt (control IDs).
- Proposed sampling: start with 1% records over the last 3 months for an initial review, with an option to increase sample size post-remediation.
- Timeline: initial package delivery in 48 hours after signature of the MAA (mutual access agreement) or equivalent — otherwise we offer redacted samples for legal review in 72 hours.

Sophia — can you confirm that a remote-only inspection with SecureAudit meets Argentum's needs? If they insist on on-site, we'll need to coordinate facilities and an updated MAP.

Irene
Director, Privacy Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs):
- 20280308-dpia-scope-checklist.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
- art30-sample-ledger-2027-q4.csv (CSV, sample extract)
- argentum-mutual-action-plan.docx (DOCX, MAP draft)
